parameters.content:
## FLOOWBOX - Investment Research Agent
Send ticker + investor type via webhook.
Perplexity fetches: recent news, financial metrics, industry context (3 parallel calls).
GPT-4o synthesizes into structured investment report.
Bull case, bear case, key risks, catalysts, analyst consensus.
Saves to Notion research library.

DISCLAIMER: Not financial advice. Always do your own research.
